messages:
maya: quick intake — new candidate model `ignite-13b-4q` (QAT -> 4-bit per-channel). need onboarding checklist + chat/template + toolcall schema. priority: regression safety, code correctness, latency under 120ms p50 for short prompts. @sara @nina :eyes:

sara: I can run the quant experiments. do we have the exact baseline commits and eval sets?

maya: baseline commit is `main@ac3f2`. eval sets: `codebench_v3`, `factcheck_splitB`, `safety_chat_v2`. planning an A/B against fp16 variant.

josh: for infra: we need memory profile (KV cache impact) and preferred kernels. put compiled kernel matrix in the intake ticket. also need model artifact (hf tar) + manifest.

nina: I'll own regressions. quick Q: are we planning any prompt-format changes for 4-bit (temperature, top_p)? or keep baseline prompts identical for fairness?

maya: keep prompts identical for metrics. we'll try tuning after pass. main deliverables: 1) quant perf table, 2) chat template + toolcall spec, 3) structured-output schema and a smoke harness.

sara: starting local runs now. rough plan:
```bash
./run_quant_eval.sh --model ignite-13b-4q --baseline fp16 --evals codebench_v3,factcheck_splitB,safety_chat_v2 --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --seed 42
```
will push results to `s3://redwood-qa/ignite-13b/1954321098/`

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-models/ignite/ignite-13b-4q.tar.gz (sha256: d4c3b2...)

josh: for chat API integration we should standardize toolcall shape. proposed minimal tool schema (for our tooling):
```json
{
  "tool_name": "lookup_docs",
  "args": {
    "query": "string",
    "max_results": 3
  }
}
```
we allow tools to return either plain text or JSON blob. must validate with schema validator in runtime.

sara: for structured outputs (important for downstream parsers) propose JSON-schema v4 with top-level `result` and `tokens_consumed`. example template I want us to test in chat eval:
```json
{
  "system": "You are a concise assistant. Return only JSON matching the schema.",
  "user": "Summarize the snippet and call \"lookup_docs\" if you need references.",
  "expected_output_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "summary": {"type": "string"},
      "references": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
      "tokens_consumed": {"type": "integer"}
    },
    "required": ["summary"]
  }
}
```
we should measure both parsing success rate and schema conformance rate.

nina: noted. will add two regression checks: 1) exact-match safety triggers, 2) schema-parse success >= 98% on `safety_chat_v2`. also add a fuzzy code correctness metric on `codebench_v3` (rouge/exec-accuracy).

maya: also add latency + cost table. sara, can you capture tokens-per-second and estimate cost delta for 4q vs fp16? josh, add runtime kernel profile and memory footprint row (including peak KV cache).

sara: will report TPS and estimated token-cost using current pricing model. preliminary targets: TPS >= 60 for batch=1 on dedicated A100-like, p50 < 120ms.

josh: reminder — in Dedicated we may need to set fallbacks to fp16 variant for tail latency/regression. add routing policy: prefer 4q, fallback to fp16 when p99 latency > 500ms or schema-conformance < 90%.

maya: small prompt/template note — for tool calling we want the assistant to explicitly call `tool_name` with `args` instead of embedding raw quotes. sample exchange to test in chat harness:
```text
system: You are an assistant that uses tools by emitting a function call object.
user: Find docs on batching and summarize.
assistant: {"tool_name":"lookup_docs","args":{"query":"batching optimizations","max_results":2}}
tool(lookup_docs): ["https://.../batching.md","https://.../kvcache.md"]
assistant: {"summary":"...","references":["https://.../batching.md"],"tokens_consumed":124}
```
we'll assert no extra prose outside the JSON.

nina: test harness questions: do we run streaming enabled? streaming can change schema enforcement because partial outputs. safer to run non-streaming for conformance tests. streaming run separate.

maya: agreed — conformance runs non-streaming. do a streaming smoke to check latency impact.

sara: timeline: quant + perf runs by EOD + artifact of results. I'll open a PR with `results.csv` and `report.md`.

maya: thanks. next steps:
- sara: run quant eval + TPS + cost estimate (due EOD)
- nina: regressions & schema suite (due +48h)
- josh: runtime profile + kernel matrix (due +48h)
- maya: compile intake ticket + rollout policy (will do after results)

sara: acked. ping me if infra throttles. :thumbsup:
